(Japanese: '''シゲル''' ''Shigeru'') is the [[rival]] of {{Zensho|Satoshi}}, who appeared in [[Pokémon Zensho]] and is directly based on {{ga|Blue}} of the [[Pokémon Red and Blue Versions|original games]]. Like Blue, Shigeru is [[Professor Oak]]'s grandson. He and his sister [[Daisy Oak|Daisy]] were raised by their grandfather after their parents died in a car accident.

==History==
Shigeru began his journey at the age of 10 around the same time as {{Zensho|Satoshi}}. He chose a {{p|Squirtle}} seeing that it would be the type-advantage of Satoshi's choice, {{p|Charmander}}. During their first battle, Squirtle was easily beaten by Charmander despite the type-advantage. He has another battle with him on the S. S. Anne with the results being the same as the previous battle. The battle they had causes {{Zensho|Satoshi's Charmander}} to evolve into a Charmeleon.

When Satoshi reached [[Fuchsia City]], he and Satoshi were at a Safari Zone with Satoshi catching a {{p|Ditto}} and a {{p|Dratini}}, with the latter being given away to a fisherman. Shigeru ends up battling and defeating [[Sabrina]] in ''[[PZ07|Saffron City]]'', which made Sabrina depressed. [[PZ09|Two chapters later around the end]], he has his {{p|Pidgeot}} attack Satoshi's Charizard while he was midair, marking his first and only win against Satoshi.

In ''[[PZ10|Indigo Plateau]]'', he ends up becoming the champion of the Pokémon League after defeating the Elite Four. He challenges Satoshi for the final time after he defeated the Elite Four too, with his Blastoise against Charizard. During the midst of their battle, one of the pillars fall down and is headed for Shigeru. Satoshi pushes Shigeru out of the way which becomes the start of their friendship. Since they are now friends instead of rivals, both of them go to the Cerulean Cave to look for the legendary Pokémon, {{p|Mewtwo}}.

==Personality and characteristics==
Like his game counterpart, he has a disdain for Satoshi but has trouble feeling empathy with his own Pokémon. He's slightly more villainous, attacking Satoshi in midair.

==Trivia==
* He shares his name with [[Gary Oak]] from {{aniseries|PTS}}. However, he is based on {{ga|Blue}}, not Gary, so his name actually comes from the optional names from the [[Pokémon Red and Blue Versions|game]], not the animated character's name. A similar situation applies to {{Zensho|Satoshi}}, Shigeru's rival and {{Ccp|Haruka}} from [[Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪]].
